summary: Implementation of a full-stack form builder system with a React DnD frontend and Express/PostgreSQL backend. Includes form creation, persistence, sharing via unique link, response collection, analytics, and CSV export.

code_files.description: Controller handling form creation, saving, retrieval, sharing, and analytics
Form model to store form metadata and field definitions
Routes for all form operations including creation, sharing, response collection, analytics, and CSV export
Database initialization and connection using Sequelize
Express application setup with routes and middleware
